errors.text_span: The MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple) generally performs better than MADLLM w/o skip embedding (light orange).
errors.evidence: This statement is an over-generalization. While the purple bar is higher than the orange bar in 3 of the 5 datasets (PSM, SMAP, MSL), the orange bar is higher in the other 2 datasets (SMD, SWaT). The word 'generally' is misleading as there is no strong, consistent trend.

errors.text_span: compared to roughly 86% and 85% for the ablated models.
errors.evidence: Regarding the SWaT dataset, this statement, combined with the order of models previously mentioned, implies that the purple bar (w/o feature embedding) is ~86% and the orange bar (w/o skip embedding) is ~85%. However, the chart shows the opposite relationship: the orange bar (~86%) is slightly higher than the purple bar (~85.5%). The description reverses the performance of the two ablated models for this dataset.
